title: THE CARD IN THE DRAWER · The box
venue: the motel · a card left in room twelve's nightstand each month by a guest never seen · Box 12
logline: The fifth card, August: a skeleton on a horse. He redraws it as a small cardboard box under a drafting table with an old dog asleep beside it — the box empty, the dog alive, the card's name not drawn anywhere on the page. Two years and four months before the box is used. He puts this card back in the drawer and it's gone in the morning.

panels.composition: A single tall card filling the page, its border drawn as the wooden edge of a motel nightstand drawer; inside the border: a small empty cardboard box beneath a drafting table with an old dog asleep against it, the lamp above, nothing else. No numeral, no title; the card's name is the thing.
